headline_summary: Intuitive Machines is the Houston-based lunar logistics and broader space systems company co-founded in 2013 by NASA JSC alum Stephen Altemus (CEO/President) and serial space entrepreneur Dr. Kamal Ghaffarian (Chairman). Public via de-SPAC February 2023 (Inflection Point Acquisition Corp; Michael Blitzer board). First private company to land on the Moon (IM-1 'Odysseus,' Feb 22 2024). FY25 revenue $250-300M; FY26 outlook $900M-$1B with positive Adjusted EBITDA. NASA CLPS contract ceiling $4.82B with $150M guaranteed near-term and $180.4M IM-5 task order for Lunar South Pole delivery on cargo-class Nova-D lander. The transformational event is the $800M Lanteris Space Systems acquisition (expected Q1 2026 close).
ceo_president: Stephen Altemus (co-founder; ex-NASA JSC Deputy Director)
chairman: Dr. Kamal Ghaffarian (co-founder; serial space entrepreneur — Stinger Ghaffarian Technologies, Axiom Space, X Energy, Quantum Space, PTX)
structural_thesis_in_one_paragraph: Intuitive Machines is the first private company to land on the Moon, a Houston NASA-pedigree lunar logistics operator now executing a transformational $800M acquisition that brings Boeing-grade satellite systems capability and roughly triples revenue in FY26. The investment proposition compresses NASA CLPS task-order execution, lunar surface operations risk (IM-1 and IM-2 both reached the Moon with operational complications), Lanteris integration, and the secular thesis that lunar logistics becomes a sustainable commercial market. The board (Ghaffarian chairman, Altemus CEO, Liquori retired LtGen Space Force, Masson ex-Raytheon CFO Naval Aviator, Blitzer Kingstown Capital founder + USA Rare Earth chair, Seligman ex-Sony President + Global GC + OpenAI director + Harvard Law magna) is unusually deep on national security and corporate governance for a small-cap space company.
